scope: Bounded public listing search, not a scrape of all US listings. Additional relative to the two prior result files available for deduplication; older unavailable runs cannot be exhaustively deduplicated.
buyer_hypothesis: 20-30 MW inference-oriented facility; IT versus total facility load, latency destinations, energization deadline and sponsor are not buyer-validated. Prefer smaller, lower-basis industrial sites. Larger and higher-price exceptions are labeled.
common_unknowns: No listing has verified deliverable 20-30 MW, energization schedule, upgrade cost, diverse carrier capacity/latency, developer interest, assignable option terms, or full title/environmental/buildable-pad diligence. Assignment probability and profit are not yet estimable. Online active status is not broker confirmation. All zoning and utility descriptions below are listing claims unless explicitly identified otherwise.
